//: Enforces the design system's core invariant: component CSS consumes tokens through the SEMANTIC layer only — never a raw hex / named / rgb-hsl colour, and never ANY primitive variable (var(--primitive-…), colour OR size). The semantic layer is what makes brand-switching and density-switching work at the component level. Scoped to component module CSS via the lint script. Sebell runs a true density setup: every spacing value scales via semantic tokens, with no fixed-primitive exceptions.
